name: Squeek Warriors: Hamster Kingdom
description: A turn-based hamster RPG whose battles react to the live Squeekchain wheel, work units and round number.

features: Wheel running state sets the party stance (Wheel frenzy attack buff or Burrow guard defence buff)
Live wheel RPM scales the attack multiplier
Victories settle against the current round for simulated SQK credits
Live Squeekchain panel with core state, RPM, work units and round
